jsesh.bzr
Class BzrToStringBuilder

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.bzr.BzrToStringBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
BzrFontBuilder
public class BzrToStringBuilder
extends java.lang.Object
implements BzrFontBuilder

A class which can be used to produce a readable representation for a BZR file. mainly for test purposes. Created: Sun Jun 2 16:34:46 2002

Author:
Serge ROSMORDUC
